name: EA Reference-to-Portal Reconstruction Process
sequence: Accept an approved website or portal reference image.
Lock the reference image as the visual source of truth.
Measure layout, colors, typography, spacing, imagery, and component boundaries.
Reconstruct the design without visual substitutions.
Overlay or rebuild functional EA Lego modules.
Compare the rendered result with the approved reference.
Require visual and functional verification before certification.

rules.mobile: The approved reference remains the visual source of truth on mobile. Never substitute an alternate mobile composition unless the approved reference explicitly defines one.
rules.functionality: Visual similarity alone cannot certify a portal. Every visible control must have a real route, drawer, modal, or workflow.
rules.production: Preview certification must complete before production promotion.
